stories.title: SpaceX catches part of its Starship rocket on return to Earth
stories.brief: SpaceX has performed the historic catch using mechanical arms nicknamed "chopsticks".

stories.title: SpaceX successfully catches top of huge Starship rocket for first time
stories.brief: The rocket stage was caught mid air using huge mechanical arms nicknamed "chopsticks".

stories.title: Officials from Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Turkiye arrive in Islamabad for 30th ECO ministerial meeting
stories.brief: Mr. Elnur Mammadov, Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Azerbaijan and Head of Delegation, arrived in Islamabad to participate in the 30th ECO Council of Ministers Meeting.

stories.title: New units buzz grows after power huddle
stories.brief: The meeting between Zardari and Sharif at the latter's Model Town residence in Lahore followed the president's earlier meeting with Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi in Nawabshah. According to a statement issued by the Prime Minister's Office, the two leaders discussed the country's overall political, economic and security situation.

stories.title: Israel kills Hamas commander in strike on Gaza camp, officials say
stories.brief: Both Hamas and IDF officials confirm the death of Samir Abu Younis, commander of the Rafah Brigade.

stories.title: SpaceX’s Starship nails a smooth return with historic catch
stories.brief: SpaceX Starship made a triumphant return to Earth, caught midair by giant mechanical ‘chopsticks’.

stories.title: Israeli air strike kills senior Hamas commander in Gaza
stories.brief: Hamas confirms the death of Rafah brigade commander Samir Abu Younis in an attack on Khan Younis on Saturday.

stories.title: Italy fines Meta €805m over accessing users' photos
stories.brief: The social media giant is accused of not informing 20 million users it had access to their photos.

stories.title: Microsoft says services fully restored after day-long global outage
stories.brief: Efforts to address the underlying problem with Outlook, Teams and Copilot are complete, the tech firm says.

stories.title: Jojo the gorilla has spent his life alone. Can he finally find a companion?
stories.brief: Jojo was poached as an infant and grew up in captivity. His keepers want to find him a friend - but it's not straightforward.

stories.title: How the Jensen Huang scandal created a headache for business-friendly Singapore
stories.brief: The scandal has cast a spotlight on Singapore's success as a chip hub - and a location for alleged illicit trade.

stories.title: Harrison shocks Nunes on UFC return to retain title
stories.brief: Kayla Harrison shocks returning great Amanda Nunes by submitting the former double champion to retain her bantamweight title at UFC 334 in New York.

stories.title: Harrison spoils Nunes' return, submits ex-champion to retain UFC crown
stories.brief: Kayla Harrison scored the biggest victory of her career Saturday, submitting former champion Amanda Nunes by rear-naked choke in Round 4 to retain her title at UFC 334.

stories.title: Ruthless Australia win record fourth Women's World Cup
stories.brief: Australia blow New Zealand away in the first half, with a hat-trick for Jaime Chapman, to win 34-10 in Brisbane and clinch a record fourth World Cup.

stories.title: Senior Hamas commander killed in Israeli strike in Gaza
stories.brief: The Israeli military said it had killed Abu Younis in a strike in the southern Gaza Strip overnight, adding that he had led the Rafah brigade since his predecessor, Nael Abu Obeid, was killed on September 15.

stories.title: Australia retain women's Rugby League World Cup
stories.brief: Winger Jaime Chapman collected a hat-trick as Australia crushed New Zealand 34-10 on Sunday with an emphatic first-half performance to clinch their fourth consecutive women's Rugby League World Cup.

stories.title: UPS cargo plane, Copa Airlines passenger jet collide at Miami airport in US
stories.brief: A UPS cargo plane and a Copa Airlines passenger jet collided at Miami International Airport in the US state of Florida late on Saturday, prompting an emergency response, local media reported.

stories.title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts missiles towards Riyadh, drones in Eastern Province
stories.brief: The Saudi-led coalition fighting Yemen's Houthis said on Sunday it had intercepted two Houthi ballistic missiles launched towards the Saudi capital Riyadh and three drones in the kingdom's oil-rich Eastern Province.

stories.title: Bahrain says its air defences intercepted several Iranian attacks
stories.brief: Israeli military officials estimate that Iran possesses more than 1,500 ballistic missiles, although regional assessments differ, according to the report. Iran's missile and drone attacks have continued to expose vulnerabilities in US military installations, radar systems and early-warning infrastructure across the Middle East, according to the report.

stories.title: ATC moves to declare Afridi absconder
stories.brief: The court ordered issuance of notices under Section 87 of the Code of Criminal Procedure after police submitted a report stating the two nominated accused could not be located.
